storyInfo: Scioppa stalls for time as he tests Evgeny's limits. Tsar Fyodor dreams about his 'sister', and discusses the progress on the citizen's forum with Witte. A Royal Guard raids the Rhodes Island temporary treatment center in Deity Grypherburg.

attributes.content: Can we talk specifics, now that it's just the two of us? You might have fooled the others, but you can't fool me.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: So that was enough to fool the others.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What did Kuznetsov do to you? Did he put any holes in you? Let me see—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Ever since that purification operation in December, everybody had tons of questions for me whenever they ran into me on the training grounds, but no one said anything today.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Is it because optimism is our nature? Does nothing else matter?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Because they believe in you, of course! The Ataman who lights the way, the war caster of legend, the great leader of the Volniki, who reap enemies like mossoat...
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Who would they believe in, if not you?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Wow, keep going, any other titles I haven't heard of?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: —But if you ask me, I would say that foolishness is our nature.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Foolish enough to not remember old grudges, foolish enough to survive, foolish enough that people in power won't suspect that we might get back at them.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I'm glad Sirka isn't here to hear it.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I'm your second-in-command now. Stop talking about our noble lady every opportunity you get.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Well, you don't like it when I bring up Pavel.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: He's been gone three years, he's probably hit it big again somewhere else. He doesn't need us to reminisce about him.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: In Baba's name, man was born to be a quartermaster. He can fill his pockets wherever he goes. If it wasn't for Oripathy...
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: He never wrote back.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Were you robbing Messengers again?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Come on, you knew where I was these past two days, Gospodin Oleg, how would I find the time?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Finally getting back on topic? Now talk. What happened?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: What I said, basically.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What about the part that's not 'basic'?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Not basic, eh... you were there when I killed Basmanov, weren't you?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You remember what he said to me?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Surrender to Kuznetsov. That's all he wants.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Stop resisting, Basmanov. It was sheer madness to commit mutiny on the front lines, not to mention your second-in-command was leaking all your plans—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I don't blame him.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I don't blame him. I don't blame anyone...
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: I just blame myself for not seeing the truth sooner.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: What truth? The obvious truth that you can't win?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The truth that the flames have already burned away houses and clothes, and will soon reach the skin and the flesh beneath... we should have awakened sooner.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: What are you talking about—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I don't blame you, truly. I knew it was you who came, when even Private Vyacheslav made it to the bridge alive to deliver the news.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: The Special Tactics Formation... the isolated, expendable, fickle executioners, the free Volniki who are never truly free—
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: All I know is that the arrival of Sechin means you won't even get a court martial.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Yet you're giving me a chance to escape, just like how you let the miners go.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: On the surface, you're just doing everything Kuznetsov told you to do. Yet even now, you're trying to give me a way out, against his wishes.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: The stalemate continues. Kuznetsov needs every soldier he can get. He will forgive, if you surrender.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Do you know the name Yakov Petrov, Major?
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What I shame.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: It's only now that I realize that there was someone who saw that the house was burning, except no one was listening to him, and called him a madman.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: That is what they will call me. Oczip Basmanov the traitor, disciple of Yakov Petrov.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: That's all I have to say, Major. I'm not surrendering. You do what you must.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: I only hope that your blade will always remember who you are.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: <p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Command Center</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 09:21</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Thirty-two klicks until the front, sir. We're seven hundred and fifty-one klicks from Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: ETA is five hours for the former and seven days for the latter.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Good work.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Oleg will relieve you in half an hour.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I can go on—
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: No you can't. Go to bed.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: This kid was on duty all day in the control room while you were away. He only took a two-hour break before coming back. Won't listen to me at all.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I was just worried!
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Stop worrying. If thinking about things ever did any good, I would have prayed to Baba for a bolt of thunder to smite Kuznetsov.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Now get out of here, I'll be checking the quarters in two hours.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Good, looks like life will go on, if anything happens to me.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Do you need your eyes checked? Did you see any of them listen to what I say?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: They will when I'm gone. You're more of a leader than I am. It was a wise move to move you out of logistics—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: It was because I made good pies and didn't let you take extra ones, wasn't it?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Well, that's part of it.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I knew you were out for vengeance.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Come on, don't say that—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You're still thinking about what Basmanov said.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: —Huh?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Maybe his ramblings made sense in his own mind, but that last thing he said was clearly a taunt.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: You trust your blade more than you trust anyone else, don't you?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Now that's unfair, of course I trust you guys more.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Idi v'banyu. We all know that they call us Volniki the free folk because we have the freedom to come together or part ways as we please—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: So, the only things we can and must trust is ourselves and our swords.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Is that a sword, anyway? Or an Arts unit? What IS it?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Never mind. Anyway, it will always know you, and it will never kill you. That's all that matters.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Oleg.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: You like to talk about Baba. Do you know who she is, or what she looks like?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: No idea. She might be Kuranta, or Liberi, or Elafia, but she couldn't be Ursus.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: All old stories that we tell to pass the time. We need stories and song to bring us together. Isn't that what your precious Sirka always said?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: ...'Our Baba put a glass house upon the legs of a fowlbeast'...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.text: Our Baba put a glass house upon the legs of a fowlbeast.
Not to move from place to place like us, but so that she could turn around and shut people out at any time.
She never asks what you want, but asks:
She takes your burdenbeast, your sword and bow, the wealth that you traded blood for;
Even the victory that made your mother proudest.
Our ancestors called her an evil witch, but they learned when they grew old—
She was simply collecting on death's behalf.
If one has nothing left to pay:
Their sword thrice-broken, their siblings all buried upon different battlefields, and with no strength left to even hate—
She no longer blocks the way, but turns her hut around, and reveals the path without echoes.

attributes.content: 'The last thing she said to us was...'
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: 'I can protect you no longer.'
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You can't carry a tune, but you remember the words well.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Sirka sang it for me a lot.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Alright, you can stop—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I often wonder, if there comes a day when even the all-powerful Baba can no longer protect us...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: How far will we go to survive?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Message from central command.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Put it through.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I see you've left the base.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: An astute observation, sir.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You should be reporting your position and status every two hours, Major Razin.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: A report every two hours is impractical. Should I explain the reason in detail?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Do not waste time on long-range communications. Report on your progress.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Well, as you know, the Volnov has left the base and is currently approaching the front lines. Assuming we do not need to linger near the front lines and observe the situation—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: There's no need. Proceed directly.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Even if it might cause the Second Army to attack?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I said, it is not your concern. What you should be concerned with is getting your men near the satellite city before you run out of power.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: There's no time for you to stop, according to my estimations. The Volnov must arrive at the designated location in three days and complete the mission in conjunction with another unit.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I don't know anything about any other unit.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Now you do.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Now, what is the current progress of the Volnov?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Scioppa takes his time glancing at the control panel before answering.
Accelerating steadily. I can't give you an accurate figure, but it will eventually reach a figure that will allow us to arrive by the ETA.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Is that so...?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Then I hope that central command will not have to initiate the next communication.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Why did you lie to him? How long can we keep this up?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: In order to survive, we must first solve our most pressing problem.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Give the Second Army enough time to react, then pray that Kuznetsov's 'guarantee' pays off before we're blown to smithereens.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Hiding by yourself again, my brother Fedya?
Why aren't you with Mother?

attributes.text: I... like your apple tree. Besides—I don't want to stay there anymore...
That smell is everywhere in the room... I don't want to go back!

attributes.content: What smell? The smell of disinfectants, of bitter almond?
The smell is from things that help Mother. I put bitter almond fragrance in my room to stop myself from coughing, and to relieve the pain...
You know that.
Because those people in black won't let me go in anymore.
They don't even want me to come near you.
She picks a low-hanging fruit and puts it in the boy's hand.
The fruit is red like agate, like the culmination of the sun of countless summers at the palace, summers that he had forgotten.
He no longer sees the red corridor in the glass palace, only the rays of the sun shining through the leaves and branches like broken glass, and the cool apple upon his palm.
He hears only the sweet, glass-like voice in his ear.
But I'll pay them no heed.
You're my only brother. Nothing can break our bonds of blood.
I'll find you.
Fedya... Fedya!
*cough* *cough* Thank goodness, you're still here.
Listen, I know you don't want to go, but you must. Go with them to Mother's funeral. Do you understand?
I can't be there, but you can...
Come, let me sort your tie out. Your pants are dirty. Did you trip again? You're always so clumsy—
Now, go.
I'll wait for you... under the apple tree.
Yes, my brave Fedya. Do not be afraid, though some may try to confuse and control you, for you are stronger than them all.
You will hear the most sincere voice, the voice of me calling to you.
And I will be here, waiting for you.
...The summer palace? Why am I dreaming about something from so long ago...?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The one in the dream... a sister?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But I have no siblings...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Argh—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (The headaches are getting more frequent.)
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (Ever since I came back from Katorga...)
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty, I bring the latest progress report on the citizen's forum.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Good timing. Saves me from thinking too much.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You look tired.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Strange, isn't it... I had a dream about the summer palace, which I have not seen in many years.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: There's a beautiful apple orchard nearby. It'll be a good place to recuperate, if you feel the need.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...Apple orchard?
attributes.name: Witte
Fyodor
attributes.content: Yes...

attributes.name: Fyodor
attributes.content: Never mind, it's not important—what's the progress?
Most nobles who were already on our side are inclined to continue, following the Katorga Incident.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: They have quickly accepted the decision to trial the citizen's forum, and a few of them are even willing to divert tax funds to establish similar pilot programs in their territories.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I believe it's a good start.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What's the catch?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I'm sure Your Imperial Majesty understands...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The Winter Emergency Resource Allocation Act will not convince the conservatives of the State Council just because it passed the citizen's forum.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It's not just the conservatives. No aristocrat will willingly give up their own profits, much less allow the council to dictate what little remains of the nation's Originium resources.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Even if it's the only way to save Ursus.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Not the only way, apparently, in the eyes of many.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The generals of the empire wallow in the dream that my father weaved for them.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Wasn't enough blood shed on Bloodpeak already? Did they think it was a glorious defeat? Ursine territory would be twice as large now, if they were half the geniuses they think they are!
attributes.name: Fyodor
Fyodor
attributes.content: Absurd... Ridiculous!

attributes.name: Fyodor
attributes.content: ...*cough* *cough*!
Please, stay your anger, Majesty, as the doctor instructs.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I expect they understand these things full well. I believe they simply want to get as big a slice of Ursus's flesh, before chaos truly descends.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: For some of them, the unity of the nation and the plight of her people pale in comparison to ensuring their own prosperity and that of their descendants.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What are you implying?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I have news.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Out with it.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Only a few people with access to the Amber Palace know that Project Zero's energy utilization research is not progressing as hoped, all of whom are under strict surveillance.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: However, our intelligence indicates that the Fourth Army began moving almost at the same time that we received the news.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: They are quietly amassing forces for another push along the front lines, while simultaneously moving in the direction of First Army territory.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: They're ready on two fronts.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: What this means is that the Fourth Army has thoroughly infiltrated not only Grypherburg, but Tsarevgrad itself.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This is a serious matter.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You wouldn't come to me with unfounded conjecture. Who do you suspect?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: (Hushed) Vasily Gorchikov.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The Vice Chairman? But isn't he the representative of the new aristocracy in the Duma—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But his family business has longstanding ties with military nobility, and the family of his late wife, House Gorchikov, is a noble house with a long and storied history.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It was by marrying into his wife's family that he was recommended to the Imperial Guard.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Objectively speaking, Vasily's position was always uncertain.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I seem to recall that there was a servant in the Amber Palace from a branch of his family. Saveliy.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: I see you catch my meaning.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: If someone in legislative leadership goes over to the pro-war faction—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Wait. Volkina, the honorary Vice Chairman who never attends meetings. She's a military noble too!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: But she never expresses her opinion.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It's her actions, not her words, that are important. The same goes for Vasily...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Keep a close eye on them. Do not let anyone get away. We must put a stop to any sign of a schism, whether superficial or material.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Understood...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: ...Are you tired, Witte?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Of course not... Majesty.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I'm beginning to feel powerless, Witte... can we really change anything? Is there anything we can do?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: There is still much we can do.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You have cast aside the shadow of your father. You must demonstrate to them that your kindness is not weakness, that it requires even greater strength.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We must not surrender to the things that you rejected.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Enough... I do not want to hear such flattery, least of all from you.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The citizen's forum is a necessary reform. We need more people to stand with us. Time is short.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The empire cannot afford any more internal strife. We cannot use violence against these dissenters.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: More patience... continue to work to persuade them, try to awaken their love for this nation, or at the very least, a little bit of conscience...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: You're right, Witte... we can't surrender yet.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: <p=1>Rhodes Island Temporary Treatment Center, Odoyev Raion, Deity Grypherburg</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: ...I should have come in the last time I passed by. It's totally different inside!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Why didn't you?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Well, I thought I would do that when there's no longer a line of patients outside the door waiting for treatment.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Now it looks like they all fit inside, even if it does get a little crowded.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I heard you helped a lot.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Not nearly enough.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Do you know, there's a girl here, one of the surviving miners from the Far North who told me the entry hall was the first area to be completed. She likes it because it's always warm and bright, even at night.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But I know that Rhodes Island had to invest in appearances first, just to satisfy the nobles and facilitate further operation.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Otherwise, they would hardly have paid attention to an Oripathy treatment center in downtown all of a sudden.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It is warm and bright, though.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: ...Sometimes I wonder whether you're just acting dumb, or—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...think, it's important.
attributes.name: Intermittent Voice
Intermittent Voice
attributes.content: But, should we wait...

attributes.name: Intermittent Voice
attributes.content: For Dur-nar to, come back?
Oh, that's the girl I was talking about.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Get everyone, indoors... warmer than, outside.
attributes.name: Vetochki
Vetochki
attributes.content: As for where, to put...

attributes.name: Vetochki
attributes.content: Oh. I can help, to carry some—
Vetochki.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: —Oh!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Sorry, did I scare you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, no! I just didn't, hear you...
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: You came again! Thank you!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Just happened to pass by. I see the streets outside are empty, and the stoves have been taken away. Have the rooms been cleared? Enough furniture and equipment for everyone?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No, not yet. Some mattresses and, sheets have arrived, but not enough, and it's so, cold outside...
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Better to have, everyone, in the hall.
attributes.name: Vetochki
Vetochki
attributes.content: Oh! At night, we'll try to, get everyone, a bed!

attributes.name: Vetochki
attributes.content: There won't be, anyone in the, hall, when there are, inspections...
...Tsk.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Listen, Vetochki, we both know that the requirements for the treatment center to be perfectly clean and tidy aren't realistic.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Forget about those for now. Just let me know if you need anything. I'll do what I can—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But you sent, the mattresses, and sheets, didn't you?
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: ...What? But I haven't gotten the new supplies yet—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Who came?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: A man, wearing clothes, like yours... he brought, the things, and a few, people.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Just now...
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: That's him!
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: ...Platon?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Tsk.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: What are you doing here?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I thought you took leave to see your sick mother?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Yes, this is one of the charities that my mother sponsors. But I'm surprised you found the time to come to Odoyev and look after these commoners, busy as you are.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: I thought His Imperial Majesty and your bright future were the only things on your mind.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: No—
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Get back.
attributes.name: Bodyguard

attributes.content: Behind me, Vetochki.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Is that so? What a coincidence.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Since when did House Lunin become a sponsor of Rhodes Island? When my family is taking full responsibility for this matter?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Perhaps you should make sure a contract is exclusive before you sign it.
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: I could say the same to you.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What ARE you doing here, Platon? You have never had the slightest interest in commoners or charity.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Yet you've started doing these things all of a sudden, with a whole retinue of bodyguards... either you've suddenly discovered the goodness in your heart, or you're putting on a performance.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: But where are your cameras and lights, if you just want to take a few touching photos for the newspapers and intercity net?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: None of your business. Do you want my sponsorship or not?
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Of course. Every little bit counts. Next time, however, I suggest you go through official channels.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: After all, it's not just Oripathy patients here, but also a group of witnesses under His Imperial Majesty's protection... you don't want to be in the position of having to explain if anything happens to them, do you?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: ...Hmph!
attributes.name: Platon

attributes.content: Where are the supplies he brought, Vetochki?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The blankets, have been, handed out... the mattresses are, still in the, warehouse.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: We're planning to, clear out, more rooms, then t-take the, mattresses out.
attributes.name: Vetochki

attributes.content: Eloysius scans the faces of the patients in the hall. They are draped in new blankets, some huddled together, others curled up on the floor.
No one wants to interrupt a moment like this.
Let me see the rest of the stuff.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: This is where the supplies he sent are stored.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Care to give a hand, Gospodin Hellagur? I would like to perform another check.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You suspect him.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: I didn't think you would be interested.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Not so much a suspicion as a hunch... but maybe it's just all the assassinations and talk of spies that's gotten me on edge.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: When you think about it, procuring this stuff represents no difficulty for his family whatsoever. It just never occurred to them to do so.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I'm supposed to be his superior, sort of, but I never managed to have a good influence on him—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: My impression is that rank works differently in the Imperial Guard from the Armies.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Unlike the Armies, which have a strict promotion hierarchy, Imperial Guards mostly graduate directly from the military academy. As members of the aristocracy, all of you start as lieutenants.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You are equal in rank, even if you hold different positions, and this will not change in the near future.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Are you saying it's normal that he resents me?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I've seen it many times. Besides, the Imperial Guard doesn't have automatic promotion by tenure.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Not to mention these are peaceful times, and not even the Great Rebellion could breach the walls of Grypherburg. There are few opportunities for merit and promotion.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You're complaining.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Of course I'm not! Besides, things are changing. What I wouldn't give to not have the opportunity to earn merit now...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Platon's family has been trying to get him into the Central Army and onto the front lines. I rejected the reassignment. I suppose it's another reason why he doesn't like me.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: If things have gotten to the point when the Central Army is mobilized, no one in Grypherburg is immune.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The Capital Ursus Guard, part of the Central Army, must stand with the Imperial Guard as the final line of defense.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It's disunity that you're concerned about.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You're much easier to talk to when you don't play dumb, you know? If the vice-chairman was here, he would tell me to stop wearing myself out and put myself and family first.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The Far North Incident has brought the schism amongst the factions of Grypherburg to the surface, while the insurrection in Katorga has raised the alarm for the fence-sitters.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I have no doubt that Grypherburg would have fallen apart in the literal sense of the word, if any of the recent assassination attempts had succeeded—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Wait, these supplies...
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Is something wrong?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: They're all military supplies. They're usually only seen in the military and the factories that supply it.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The council may occasionally divert military supplies in the event of an emergency, but Platon? How did he get his hands on these things?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: What was he doing here?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Hmph... hah.
...Who's there?!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Colluding with traitors under the pretense of an Infected treatment center. Just as I thought.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Tell me, lieutenant.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Where is the traitor?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade
